input.rationale: Direct wind damage to insured structure (roof shingles). Clear property damage claim with no third-party liability or theft elements involved.
Estimated loss of $400 is well below the $5,000 low-severity threshold. Localized damage to four shingles with no water intrusion or secondary damage. Simple repair scope.

input.claim_summary: Claim for wind damage to back porch roof overhang. Approximately four shingles blown off during windstorm last weekend. Estimated repair cost: $400. No water intrusion or secondary damage reported. Policyholder: Jordan Lee (POL-1006). Policy deductible: $2,500. Claim is below deductible and will be out-of-pocket for policyholder. Documented for records and future reference.
